events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Raise a glass to Liam Gallagher, still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude at 54. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message and a truly classic album. What's your favourite track?

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto your first one?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Bond. James Bond. It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. An absolute masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your standout track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal album for The Beatles, 'Rubber Soul' turns 61 today. It marked a new direction for the Fab Four. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music legend John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His legacy as a musician, songwriter, and advocate for peace lives on. Share your favourite John Lennon song.
